verdict.rationale: Baseten's async inference is explicitly positioned as suited for 'batch work, long documents' via request-ID + webhook/polling, which supports processing many items without holding connections open, and rate-limit/usage docs suggest handling volume. However there's no documented explicit batch-submission API (e.g., submit N items in one call) or bulk management operations across many models/deployments. Missing for 10: a dedicated batch/bulk inference endpoint spec, bulk deployment/management API, and any hands-on evidence of processing large item sets at once.
